instruction: Update all my Spotify playlist titles with the most common song genre in that playlist in this format: "<original_title> | <most_common_genre>". Replace <original_title> and <most_common_genre> with the actual values.
notes: Single-app task (spotify). Flow: get passwords, login, list the playlist library (discovers playlist ids/titles), for each playlist show_playlist (discovers song ids), show_song for every song (discovers genre), then update_playlist with title '<original_title> | <most_common_genre>', and finally complete_task with no answer. Because quantified/derived conditions are not allowed, completeness of genre inspection per playlist is tracked with discrete count objects (songs-checked vs song-count), and completeness of updates with playlists-updated vs playlist-count; these count parameters are not API arguments. The problem instance is representative (2 playlists with 3 and 2 songs); the real number of playlists and songs per playlist is read at runtime from show_playlist_library / show_playlist and the problem should be instantiated accordingly. Only the title field of each playlist is changed (is_public is not passed), matching the evaluation that only titles change and no playlists are added/removed.

plan: (spotify-update-playlist playlist-1 spotify-token new-title-playlist-1 c3 c0 c1)
(spotify-update-playlist playlist-2 spotify-token new-title-playlist-2 c2 c1 c2)
